game.name: Single Player
game.desc: Play Minecraft full screen with your Microsoft account.

game.name: Split Screen
game.desc: Two players side by side. Player 1 picks a world and opens it to LAN; Player 2 joins automatically with an offline account.

game.name: Manage Minecraft
game.desc: Install, update and remove mods from Modrinth. Every mod goes to Player 1 and Player 2, so Split Screen keeps working.

game.name: Prism Launcher
game.desc: Open Prism Launcher to sign in with a Microsoft account and manage instances.
